newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 183 of July 11, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 183 of July 11, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

COMMISSION DECISION of 25 June 1997 laying down special conditions for the import of live bivalve molluscs, echinoderms, tunicates and marine gastropods originating in Australia (Text with EEA relevance) (97/427/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 25 June 1997 laying down special conditions governing the import of fishery and aquaculture products originating in Australia (Text with EEA relevance) (97/426/EC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1335/97 of 10 July 1997 fixing the agricultural conversion rates
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1334/97 of 10 July 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1333/97 of 10 July 1997 temporarily suspending the issue of export licences for certain milk products and determining the extent to which export licences may be issued against applications currently pending
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1332/97 of 10 July 1997 derogating, for Portugal, from the marketing standards applicable to melons

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1331/97 of 10 July 1997 derogating from Commission Regulation (EC) No 1223/94 laying down special detailed rules for the application of the system of advance-fixing certificates for certain agricultural products exported in the form of goods not covered by Annex II to the Treaty, and derogating from Commission Regulation (EEC) No 3665/87 laying down common detailed rules for the application of the system of export refunds on agricultural products
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1330/97 re of 10 July 1997 on the issuing of import licences for bananas under the tariff quota for the third quarter of 1997 (second period)

COUNCIL REGULATION (ECSC, EC, EURATOM) No 1329/97 of 7 July 1997 adjusting the weighting applicable in Greece to the remuneration and pensions of officials and other servants of the European Communities END OF DOCUMENT.
